hardwareProfile.description:
If {@link HardwareProfile} is provided, then a server node matching this profile will be identified such that
the action is executed there.

interruptInSec.description: Number of seconds to wait before interrupting the action.

gracePeriodInSec.description: Additional number of seconds to wait on calling server before interrupting

onlyWorkers.description: If `true` then this action on only all worker nodes.

onlyMasters.description: If `true` then this action on only all master nodes.

nodes.description: If the server nodes is set then action will be sent to these nodes.

title: Specification for where action should be multi-casted.
name: ActionMulticastTargetSpec
